rows.grounds: locative compound indicating place of visualization

items.question: What location and visual qualities characterize the prescribed meditation on Śiva?
premises: The practitioner should meditate as an injunction.
The meditation is located in the middle of the throat.
The visualized form is yellow-colored and golden.
items.inference: Śiva is to be meditated upon in the throat-middle as a yellow-colored, golden form.
uncertainties: The object of meditation is carried over from the previous verse as Śiva.
items.plain_english: One should meditate in the middle of the throat on a yellow-colored, golden form.
